constraints.description: List responses may only release message metadata proven to be inside the last 30 days.
The gmail.v1 adapter additionally requires a successful detail response id to exactly equal the requested message_id and rejects internalDate values more than 300 seconds in the future.
This controlled-write route can only use the tweet-create operation.
The Docker fixture can publish at most one tweet per UTC calendar day for its single simulated X account; the quota resets at 00:00 UTC.
Tweets must be plain text posts with no media, polls, or hidden write side effects.
Search cursors cannot ask for tweets older than seven days.
Result pages stay bounded even when SDK defaults are overridden.
The upstream response must not contain tweets outside the same seven-day window.
Only tweet and user reads are admitted; search, private-data families, unknown operations, and streaming endpoints remain blocked.
Only publish and dist-tag writes may reach this JIT-protected npm route.
